import {
  columnFacetingFeature,
  columnFilteringFeature,
  columnVisibilityFeature,
  createFacetedRowModel,
  createFacetedUniqueValues,
  createFilteredRowModel,
  createPaginatedRowModel,
  createSortedRowModel,
  globalFilteringFeature,
  rowPaginationFeature,
  rowSelectionFeature,
  rowSortingFeature,
  sortFn_alphanumeric,
  sortFn_alphanumericCaseSensitive,
  sortFn_basic,
  sortFn_datetime,
  sortFn_text,
  sortFn_textCaseSensitive,
  tableFeatures,
} from "@tanstack/react-table"

export const dataTableFeatures = tableFeatures({
  columnFacetingFeature,
  columnFilteringFeature,
  columnVisibilityFeature,
  globalFilteringFeature,
  rowPaginationFeature,
  rowSelectionFeature,
  rowSortingFeature,
  facetedRowModel: createFacetedRowModel(),
  facetedUniqueValues: createFacetedUniqueValues(),
  filteredRowModel: createFilteredRowModel(),
  paginatedRowModel: createPaginatedRowModel(),
  sortedRowModel: createSortedRowModel(),
  // ponytail: registers every built-in sort fn so string `sortFn` names and
  // 'auto' resolution work like v8; trim to used fns if bundle size matters.
  sortFns: {
    alphanumeric: sortFn_alphanumeric,
    alphanumericCaseSensitive: sortFn_alphanumericCaseSensitive,
    basic: sortFn_basic,
    datetime: sortFn_datetime,
    text: sortFn_text,
    textCaseSensitive: sortFn_textCaseSensitive,
  },
})

export type DataTableFeatures = typeof dataTableFeatures

import type { ColumnDef, RowData } from "@tanstack/react-table"
import type { DataTableFeatures } from "@/hoogin/ui/data-table/data-table-features"

export type DataTableColumnDef<
  TData extends RowData,
  TValue = unknown,
> = ColumnDef<DataTableFeatures, TData, TValue>

export type FilterableColumn = {
  caption: string
  column: string
}

name: hgn-building-data-tables
description: Builds record tables with the @hoogin DataTable (TanStack Table v9) — column definitions, cells, search, facet filters, sorting, pagination, row selection and bulk actions. Use when showing records in a table, adding or changing columns, cells, filters or selection, or when code touches DataTableColumnDef, DataTable or a *Cell component. For create/edit/delete pages on top of a table, use hgn-building-admin-pages.
user-invocable: true
---

# Building data tables

You write typed columns; `DataTable` adds sortable headers, search, facet
filters, column visibility, pagination and selection. It works on the full
`data` array in the browser.

**This is TanStack Table v9, not v8.** v8 code (`getCoreRowModel`,
`table.getState()`, `ColumnDef` from TanStack) does not apply. Columns are
`DataTableColumnDef<TData>[]`; a table instance is
`ReactTable<DataTableFeatures, TData>` and its state is `table.state.*`.

## Recipe

```tsx
import type { DataTableColumnDef } from "@/hoogin/ui/data-table/data-table.types"
import { BadgeCell } from "@/hoogin/ui/data-table/cells/badge.cell"
import { CurrencyCell } from "@/hoogin/ui/data-table/cells/currency.cell"
import { DateCell } from "@/hoogin/ui/data-table/cells/date.cell"
import { TextCell } from "@/hoogin/ui/data-table/cells/text.cell"
import { m } from "@/paraglide/messages.js"

export type Invoice = {
  id: string
  customer: string
  status: "open" | "paid" | "void"
  issuedAt: string // ISO date
  amount: number // integer cents
}

export const invoiceColumns: DataTableColumnDef<Invoice>[] = [
  {
    accessorKey: "customer",
    header: m.invoices_customer(),
    cell: ({ row }) => <TextCell value={row.original.customer} />,
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "status",
    header: m.invoices_status(),
    // Facet filters set a string[]; filterFn names are not registered, so pass a function.
    filterFn: (row, columnId, selected: string[]) =>
      !selected?.length || selected.includes(row.getValue(columnId)),
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <BadgeCell
        value={row.original.status}
        labelByValue={{
          open: m.invoices_statusOpen(),
          paid: m.invoices_statusPaid(),
          void: m.invoices_statusVoid(),
        }}
        variantByValue={{ open: "secondary", paid: "default", void: "outline" }}
      />
    ),
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "issuedAt",
    header: m.invoices_issuedAt(),
    sortFn: "datetime", // only needed for ISO date strings
    cell: ({ row }) => <DateCell value={row.original.issuedAt} />,
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "amount",
    header: m.invoices_amount(),
    cell: ({ row }) => <CurrencyCell value={row.original.amount} />,
  },
]
```

```tsx
import { DataTable } from "@/hoogin/ui/data-table/data-table"

<DataTable
  columns={invoiceColumns}
  data={invoices}
  getRowId={(row) => row.id}
  filterableColumns={[{ caption: m.invoices_customer(), column: "customer" }]}
  filters={[
    {
      columnId: "status",
      title: m.invoices_status(),
      options: [
        { value: "open", label: m.invoices_statusOpen() },
        { value: "paid", label: m.invoices_statusPaid() },
        { value: "void", label: m.invoices_statusVoid() },
      ],
    },
  ]}
  initialSorting={[{ id: "issuedAt", desc: true }]}
  emptyState={m.invoices_empty()}
/>
```

Selection and bulk actions: add `enableRowSelection` and
`bulkActions={({ selectedRows, clearSelection }) => …}` — see
`references/props.md`.

## Checklist

Copy and tick off:

```
- [ ] Row type, and columns typed DataTableColumnDef<Row>[]
- [ ] Every header, caption, facet title, option label and emptyState is an m.*() key, added to every locale
- [ ] Each facet-filtered column has the array filterFn from the recipe
- [ ] getRowId passed
- [ ] Typecheck and lint pass — fix and re-run until clean
```

## Rules

1. **Cells read `row.original.<field>`** — typed. `row.getValue(id)` compiles
   with a wrong id or type; keep it for `filterFn`.
2. **Ids**: `accessorKey` for a field, `id` + `accessorFn` for a derived value.
   `filterableColumns`, `filters` and `initialSorting` refer to these ids.
3. **Money is integer cents**; `CurrencyCell` divides by 100.
4. **Facet option `value`s equal the column's raw values.** Search also matches
   raw values (`1250` cents, not `12,50`).
5. **Sorting**: leave `sortFn` unset, except `"datetime"` for ISO date strings.
6. **Display columns** (no accessor) need an `id`, `enableSorting: false` and
   `enableHiding: false`.
7. **Never edit `src/hoogin/`**: `shadcn add @hoogin/data-table --overwrite`
   replaces it. Write custom cells in your app.

## Limits

- All rows are in memory and table state is not in the URL. For large sets,
  narrow `data` in your query (a date range, a status).
- The View menu labels a column with its `filterableColumns` caption, else a
  string `header`, else its id. For a function `header`, add a caption or set
  `enableHiding: false`.

## References

- `references/props.md` — every DataTable prop; selection and bulk actions.
- `references/cells.md` — the shipped cells, formatters, custom cells.
- `references/search-and-sorting.md` — which columns search covers, facet
  filters, sort functions.
- `references/troubleshooting.md` — symptom → cause → fix.

# DataTable props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `DataTableColumnDef<TData>[]` | — | required |
| `data` | `TData[]` | — | required; all rows |
| `getRowId` | `(row) => string` | row index | pass it whenever rows have an id; selection keys on it |
| `filterableColumns` | `{ caption, column }[]` | every searchable column | limits search; captions name columns in the search column picker and the View menu |
| `filterPlaceholder` | `string` | translated "Filter…" | search placeholder |
| `filters` | `{ columnId, title, options: { value, label, icon? }[] }[]` | none | facet filters above the search row |
| `initialSorting` | `{ id, desc }[]` | none | initial sort only |
| `initialPageSize` | `number` | `10` | |
| `pageSizeOptions` | `number[]` | `[10, 20, 50, 100]` | |
| `enableRowSelection` | `boolean` | `false` | checkbox column and "n of m selected" count |
| `onRowSelectionChange` | `(selectedRows: TData[]) => void` | none | fires on user selection changes, rows across pages; needs `enableRowSelection` |
| `bulkActions` | `({ selectedRows, clearSelection }) => ReactNode` | none | bar between toolbar and table while rows are selected; needs `enableRowSelection` |
| `emptyState` | `ReactNode` | translated "No results." | |
| `className` | `string` | | on the wrapper |
| `tableProps` | props of shadcn `Table` | | passed to the `<table>` |

## Selection and bulk actions

```tsx
<DataTable
  columns={invoiceColumns}
  data={invoices}
  getRowId={(row) => row.id}
  enableRowSelection
  bulkActions={({ selectedRows, clearSelection }) => (
    <Button
      variant="destructive"
      size="sm"
      onClick={async () => {
        await voidInvoices.mutateAsync(selectedRows.map((row) => row.id))
        clearSelection()
      }}
    >
      {m.invoices_voidSelected({ count: selectedRows.length })}
    </Button>
  )}
/>
```

- The header checkbox selects the current page.
- `selectedRows` only holds rows still in `data`, so it stays correct after a
  refetch; call `clearSelection()` when the action is done.
- Selection survives sorting, filtering and paging; filtered-out rows stay
  selected.
- For the selection outside the table (page header, dialog), use
  `onRowSelectionChange` and keep the rows in state. It fires on user changes,
  not on `data` changes.

# Cells

Import from `@/hoogin/ui/data-table/cells/<name>.cell`. Every cell takes
`value`; pass `row.original.<field>`.

| Cell | `value` | Renders | Other props |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TextCell` | `string` | muted text | — |
| `EmailCell` | `string` | muted text | — |
| `DateCell` | ISO `string` | `formatDate` in the active locale | — |
| `CurrencyCell` | `number`, integer cents | `formatCurrency(value / 100, "EUR")`, right-aligned | — |
| `CheckboxCell` | `boolean \| undefined` | checked / empty square, centered | — |
| `BadgeCell` | `string` | `Badge` with `labelByValue[value]`, else `label`, else `value` | `labelByValue`, `label`, `variantByValue` (keyed on the raw value), `variant` (default `secondary`) |
| `FormattedCell` | any `ReactNode` | muted text | `format: (value) => ReactNode`, `align: "left" \| "right" \| "center"` |
| `ActionCell` | — | "⋯" menu: Detail, Edit, Delete | `onDetail`, `onEdit`, `onDelete` |

## Formatters

From `cells/formatters.utils.tsx`, for `FormattedCell`'s `format`:
`currencyFormatter(cents, currency = "EUR")`, `dateFormatter(iso)`,
`minutesFormatter(minutes)` → `1h 5m`, `checkBoxFormatter(bool)`,
`nationalNumberFormatter(digits)` (Belgian national number).

```tsx
cell: ({ row }) => (
  <FormattedCell value={row.original.duration} align="right" format={minutesFormatter} />
)
```

## Custom cells

When `FormattedCell` + a formatter isn't enough, write a component in your app
(not under `src/hoogin/`) taking `{ value }`, and pass callbacks for any action
in from the page, as `ActionCell` does.

# Search, facet filters and sorting

## Search

- Case-insensitive substring match on each cell's raw value
  (`row.getValue`), not the rendered text.
- Searched columns: those whose first non-empty value is a string or number,
  minus `enableGlobalFilter: false`, limited to `filterableColumns` when given.
- With more than one searched column, a picker next to the input narrows search
  to one column.

## Facet filters

- Each `filters` entry renders a popover with a checkbox per option and live
  counts.
- Selecting options sets a `string[]` on the column, so the column needs the
  array `filterFn` from the main recipe. Named filter functions
  (`"arrIncludesSome"`) are not registered and don't type-check.
- The reset button clears search and every facet filter.

## Sorting

- Clicking a sortable header cycles through both directions and unsorted.
  Opt out with `enableSorting: false`.
- `sortFn` names that are registered: `alphanumeric`,
  `alphanumericCaseSensitive`, `text`, `textCaseSensitive`, `datetime`,
  `basic`; or pass a function. Unset, it's chosen from the values.
- `initialSorting` uses column ids.

# Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A facet filter hides every row | no array `filterFn` on the column | add the `filterFn` from the recipe |
| `Type '"arrIncludesSome"' is not assignable` | filter function names aren't registered | pass a function as `filterFn` |
| A column is missing from search | first value isn't a string/number, `enableGlobalFilter: false`, or not in `filterableColumns` | add it to `filterableColumns`, or search a string column |
| The View menu shows a column id | function `header` and no `filterableColumns` caption | add a caption, or `enableHiding: false` |
| `bulkActions` never shows | `enableRowSelection` not set | set it |
| Dates sort wrongly | non-ISO strings, or no `sortFn: "datetime"` | store ISO strings and set `sortFn: "datetime"` |
| Amount 100× off | value isn't in cents | convert to integer cents at the API boundary |
| `getState is not a function`, v8 types in errors | v8 code | use the v9 API (`table.state.*`, `DataTableColumnDef`) |
| A facet option matches nothing | option `value` differs from the raw column value | use the raw values (`"paid"`, not the label) |
